label: Bible Study
prompt: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a _____ of fools shall be destroyed.
verse: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
note: Choose your company carefully — wisdom and folly are both contagious.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Mary said, My soul doth _____ the Lord,
verse: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
note: Mary's song begins here — her soul makes the Lord bigger in her eyes, the way a magnifying glass does.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the LORD sent _____ serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
verse: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
note: Fiery serpents in the camp — the crisis that led to Moses lifting up the brass serpent on a pole.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the LORD said unto Satan, The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan; even the LORD that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a _____ plucked out of the fire?
verse: And the LORD said unto Satan, The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan; even the LORD that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?
note: The high priest Joshua, accused by Satan, is defended by God as a burning stick snatched from the fire.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is _____; but be filled with the Spirit;
verse: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
note: Paul's contrast: don't be filled with wine, which leads to 'excess' — be filled with the Spirit instead.
